Europe saw its colonies as a source of raw material and a __malleable__ workforce.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is "**compliant**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "**Malleable**" means able to be shaped or formed easily; pliable. It can also be used to describe people or groups that are easily influenced or controlled. (आसानी से आकार देने या बनने में सक्षम; लचीला। इसका उपयोग उन लोगों या समूहों का वर्णन करने के लिए भी किया जा सकता है जो आसानी से प्रभावित या नियंत्रित होते हैं।)

 
 
• **For example, ***"The artist was able to create a sculpture out of the **malleable** clay, molding it into the desired shape."*
 
• In this sentence given, Europe saw its colonies as a source of raw material that could be easily shaped or formed to meet their needs, as well as a workforce that could be easily controlled and manipulated.__
 
 

__** Let's see the meanings of the given words**__

 
• **Compliant**: willing to comply with rules or requests; obedient. (आज्ञाकारी: नियमों या अनुरोधों का पालन करने को तैयार।)

 
 
• **Example**:* "The new employee was **compliant** with all company policies."*
 
 
 
• **Hard**: difficult to do or achieve; challenging. (कठिन: करना या प्राप्त करना कठिन; चुनौतीपूर्ण।) 
 
 
• **Example**: *"The final exam was **hard** for many students."*
 
 
 
• **Intractable**: difficult to control or deal with; stubborn. (दुष्यकर: जिसे नियंत्रित करना या उससे निपटना मुश्किल हो; ज़िद्दी।)
 
 
• **Example**:* "The problem proved to be **intractable**, despite repeated attempts to solve it."*
 
 
 
• **Inveigle**: deceive or trick someone. (छल करना: किसी को धोखा देना।)
 
 
• **Example**:* "He tried to **inveigle** her into giving him her money."*
 
 

**According to the meanings of the given words, ***the correct answer is **Option 1, i.e., compliant.***

He was __dumbfounded__ by the allegations.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is "**dumbstruck**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dumbfounded** means to be overwhelmed with amazement or confusion. (अवाक का अर्थ है विस्मय या भ्रम से अभिभूत होना। उदाहरण: "जब मैंने हीरे की अंगूठी का आकार देखा तो मैं अवाक रह गया।")

 
 
• **Example**: *"I was **dumbfounded** when I saw the size of the diamond ring."*
 
 

**Let's see the meanings of the given words**__

__
 
• **Dumbstruck** is a synonym of dumbfounded and means to be struck speechless with amazement or surprise. (हक्का - बक्का रह जाना डंबफाउंडेड का पर्याय है और इसका अर्थ विस्मय या आश्चर्य से अवाक रह जाना है। उदाहरण: "जब उसने हवाई अड्डे पर उसकी प्रतीक्षा कर रहे लोगों की संख्या देखी तो वह दंग रह गया।")

 
 
• **Example**:* "He was **dumbstruck** when he saw the number of people waiting for him at the airport."*
 
 
 
• **Retire** means to withdraw from one's position or occupation. (निवृत्ति का अर्थ है अपने पद या व्यवसाय से हट जाना। उदाहरण: "उन्होंने 40 साल तक काम करने के बाद नौकरी से रिटायर होने का फैसला किया।")
 
 
• **Example**: *"He decided to **retire** from his job after working for 40 years."*
 
 
 
• **Consecrate** means to make or declare something sacred or dedicated to a religious purpose. (अर्पण किया हुआ का अर्थ है किसी धार्मिक उद्देश्य के लिए पवित्र या समर्पित कुछ बनाना या घोषित करना। उदाहरण: "चर्च को बिशप द्वारा पवित्र किया गया था।")
 
 
• **Example**: *"The church was **consecrated** by the bishop."*
 
 
 
• **Verdant** means lush and green with vegetation. (सब्ज़ का अर्थ है हरा-भरा और वनस्पतियों से युक्त।")
 
 
• **Example**: *"The **verdant** hills were a sight to behold."*
 
 

**According to the meanings of the given words**, *the correct answer is **Option 1, i.e., dumbstruck.***
